subject: Urgent: Peregrine production latency/errors — credit & remediation
messages:
From: Lindsay Grey <lindsay.grey@peregrinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@peregrinehealth.com, ops@peregrinehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-22T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting Peregrine - request for credit and remediation

Mina,

We're seeing sustained elevated latencies (tail p99 > 2s) and a spike in 5xx errors across our inference workload since ~2027-04-20 22:00 UTC. This has materially impacted our customer-facing features and marketing-driven traffic spikes over the last 48 hours. We've attached a CSV with sample metrics for the 4/20-4/22 window.

We need:
- A remedial plan and timeline for immediate fixes.
- An initial proposal for service credits for the affected window.
- Confirmation of any fallback/mitigation options (model variant routing, temporary rate-limits, etc.).

Procurement will need a formal amendment that documents the credit and any SLA clarifications. Given business impact, this will likely require executive review on our side. Please escalate accordingly.

Attachment: [peregrine-service-metrics.csv (CSV, 152KB)]

Regards,
Lindsay Grey
Head of Platform Operations
Peregrine Health
lindsay.grey@peregrinehealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsay Grey <lindsay.grey@peregrinehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting Peregrine - request for credit and remediation

Thanks Lindsay — I'm very sorry for the impact and appreciate the data you sent. We're treating this as a Sev2+ escalation and have opened internal ticket RDW-3214.

Immediate actions we're taking:
- Marcus is running a rolling configuration rollback on the inference pool to remove an experimental batching optimization that correlates with the spike.
- We're enabling a warm-KV cache and short-circuiting long-running requests for heavy payloads as a short-term mitigation.
- Laura will draft a Service Improvement Plan and credit proposal for your review; I will coordinate legal/finance for the amendment.

Can you confirm the exact customer-impact windows you want covered for the credit calculation (UTC)? The CSV looks like 2027-04-20 22:00 -> 2027-04-22 05:30 UTC but I want to be explicit. We'll aim to have an initial remediation plan and credit estimate by EOD today.

We also propose a remediation call (30 min) today at 4:30pm PT / 23:30 UTC. Please tell us if that works or propose an alternate.

Attachment: [RDW-3214-notes.txt (plain text, 4KB)]

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting Peregrine - request for credit and remediation

Mina / team — quick technical update:
- Confirmed correlation between the new batching fallback heuristic and elevated tail latencies under cold-KV pressure. Rolling back that heuristic restored p95/p99 to baseline in our internal repro.
- Root cause: a kernel selection path regressed behavior for small-batch mixed-size requests when combined with a specific quantization profile.
- Immediate mitigation: rollback + KV warm-up + short TTL on cache keys for large payloads. Medium term: pin quantization profile for critical routes and add canary traffic shaping.

Credit math (initial proposal):
- Affected window: 2027-04-20 22:00 -> 2027-04-22 05:30 UTC (as Mina suggested).
- Measured user-facing error spike: +7.6% over baseline; latency tail exceeded SLO for ~31% of requests in window.
- Suggested commercial offset: 12% of billable usage for the affected window (we can model alternatives: 15% or a fixed $ figure if preferred).

I'll attach the raw aggregation and timeline once it's sanitized for customer sharing. Legal will need to approve text for the amendment; recommend we surface a clean amendment draft to Procurement with options.

Marcus
Senior Reliability Engineer
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Lindsay Grey <lindsay.grey@peregrinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@peregrinehealth.com, ops@peregrinehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-22T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Production latency & errors affecting Peregrine - request for credit and remediation

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 9:05 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Lindsay — I'm very sorry for the impact and appreciate the data you sent. We're treating this as a Sev2+ escalation and have opened internal ticket RDW-3214.
> 
> Immediate actions we're taking:
> - Marcus is running a rolling configuration rollback on the inference pool to remove an experimental batching optimization that correlates with the spike.
> - We're enabling a warm-KV cache and short-circuiting long-running requests for heavy payloads as a short-term mitigation.
> - Laura will draft a Service Improvement Plan and credit proposal for your review; I will coordinate legal/finance for the amendment.

Thanks for the quick triage. Procurement here needs a formal amendment document that:
1) States the agreed credit (percentage or fixed) and the exact window covered.
2) Describes the remediation commitments (SIP) and timeline.
3) Outlines a post-incident verification step and a rollback/fallback guarantee for similar future events.

We will need exec confirmation on our side if the credit exceeds 10% or requires invoicing adjustments. Please include a named Redwood exec in the amendment who can sign or escalate.

We can do the 4:30pm PT call; I'll invite ops and procurement.

—Lindsay
Head of Platform Ops
Peregrine Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsay Grey <lindsay.grey@peregrinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Peregrine production latency/errors — credit & remediation

Lindsay — thanks again for the call yesterday.

Please find attached two items for your review: a concise Service Improvement Plan (SIP) and a draft amendment that memorializes the credit. Highlights:
- Credit: Redwood proposes a 12% credit applied to billable usage in the window 2027-04-20 22:00 -> 2027-04-22 05:30 UTC.
- SIP: short-term (rollback + KV warm-up + 48-hour intensified monitoring), medium-term (pin quantization profile, traffic shaping canaries), long-term (kernel selection test suite + additional preflight).
- Verification: Redwood will share post-deploy telemetry and a joint verification call 7 days after rollout.
- Exec signatory: I can sign as Head of Customer Solutions; if procurement requires C-level acknowledgement we can route to our COO with an expedited approval.

Attachment: [remediation-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 124KB); amendment-draft.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]

If this is acceptable in principle, please confirm and Procurement can route us any internal PO or DocuSign flow. We'll aim to finalize language and send to legal by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: procure@peregrinehealth.com <procure@peregrinehealth.com>

Cc: Lindsay Grey <lindsay.grey@peregrinehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: Peregrine production latency/errors — credit & remediation

Laura / Mina — Procurement has reviewed the draft amendment. We accept the 12% credit proposed, covering the window 2027-04-20 22:00 -> 2027-04-22 05:30 UTC, subject to a final DocuSign. Please send the final DocuSign link to this address and cc Lindsay.

For accounting: we'll need the amendment to reference invoice #PH-2027-04 once issued and a short cover note confirming that the credit will be applied as a post-invoice adjustment. If Redwood prefers a fixed-dollar credit, include both calculations in the DocuSign packet.

Procurement (on behalf of Peregrine Health)
procure@peregrinehealth.com
